description: This file defines classes for managing an online quiz interface, including quiz initialization, question rendering, timer management, and submission handling.

classes.name: Quiz
classes.description: Handles quiz lifecycle, rendering questions, managing timer, and submitting responses.

classes.name: Question
classes.description: Represents individual quiz questions, options, and user interactions.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches quiz data and initializes the quiz interface.

methods.name: get_quiz
methods.description: Calls backend to retrieve quiz data.

methods.name: make
methods.description: Builds quiz questions and handles completion state.

methods.name: initialiseTimer
methods.description: Starts countdown timer for timed quizzes.

methods.name: calculate_and_display_time
methods.description: Updates timer display with remaining time.

methods.name: append_zero
methods.description: Formats time values with leading zeros.

methods.name: make_actions
methods.description: Creates submit button for the quiz.

methods.name: set_quiz_footer
methods.description: Displays quiz result message and score.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables all questions to prevent further editing.

methods.name: get_selected
methods.description: Retrieves selected answer(s) for the question.
